title: The future of Paris's Tour Montparnasse hangs in the balance as co-owners feud
subhead: With just three months to go before the building permit for the transformation of the Paris skyscraper expires, a series of unexpected twists has shaken the project launched a decade ago. In July, Paris Mayor Emmanuel Grégoire urged the co-owners to settle their disputes. Le Monde takes a look behind the scenes at the ongoing negotiations.

title: 'Combining an organic and more plant-based diet benefits both our health and the environment'
subhead: Epidemiologist and nutrition expert Emmanuelle Kesse-Guyot tells Le Monde that organic farming offers a real advantage for fighting climate change, provided that we are willing to change our eating habits.

title: The eternal Rome of Maria Grazia Chiuri, Fendi's creative director
subhead: Maria Grazia Chiuri's hometown is where she unveiled her first haute couture collection and where an exhibition looks back at the long history that united Karl Lagerfeld with the brand. Together, they celebrate the very essence of Roman elegance.

subhead: Climate concerns are increasingly becoming a key factor when buying an apartment or house. Coastal areas and those at higher altitudes, thought to be better protected from extreme heat, are particularly attractive to potential buyers.

title: The Suez Canal: Birth and death of a colonial myth
subhead: 'Suez, a historic canal' (1/6). In 1869, the creation of a maritime route linking the Mediterranean Sea and the Red Sea, operated by the French and the British, captivated Europe. Initially a symbol of colonial oppression for the Egyptian people, the waterway became a tool of emancipation when President Nasser announced its nationalization 70 years ago, on July 26, 1956.

title: Ulrich Siegmund, the rising star of Germany's far right, electrifies crowds and rattles Berlin
subhead: The lead candidate in the regional elections in Saxony-Anhalt, scheduled for September 6, could allow the far-right Alternative für Deutschland (AfD) to govern a German state for the first time since the founding of the Federal Republic. Behind his polished and appealing exterior, this former air freshener salesman champions a radical platform.
